confidence_notes: Restaurant meal and coffee anchors agree closely across 2026 web sources (crowd-sourced Numbeo Benidorm data, Costa Blanca guides, Spain-wide ranges); beer and cocktail sources vary by venue type. No direct Benidorm wine-by-the-glass price was found, so the wine glass is set at about 1.15 times the beer anchor and cross-checked against Spain-wide ranges. Euro prices were converted at an approximate, unverified rate of about 1.15 USD per EUR. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not inspected from booking pages or listings; no accommodation searches were run. FX is the RBA 4pm rate for 2026-11-18 from a search restricted to rba.gov.au; no 2026-11-19 figure was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink basis is Benidorm itself (Costa Blanca resort pricing) with Spain-wide ranges as a cross-check; accommodation is benchmarked to other Spanish Mediterranean beach resorts at July peak season.
